atoms.name: catalogue_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students may request catalogues from the campus LAN at the beginning of semester.

atoms.name: register_course_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students may register only for their own current-semester selections while registration is open.

atoms.name: add_course_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students may add only their own current selections during add/drop while registration is open.

atoms.name: update_course_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students may update only their own current selections during add/drop while registration is open.

atoms.name: delete_course_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students may delete only their own current selections during add/drop while registration is open.

atoms.name: report_card_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students may view only their own previous-semester report cards from the campus LAN.

atoms.name: select_teaching_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Professors may select eligible upcoming offerings only while registration is open and conflict-free.

atoms.name: modify_assigned_offering_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Professors may modify only their own assigned offerings while registration is open.

atoms.name: view_roster_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Professors may view rosters only for offerings they teach.

atoms.name: enter_grade_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only the professor for a completed previous-semester class may enter grades.

atoms.name: student_info_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only the registrar may change student information.

atoms.name: close_registration_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only the registrar may close current registration.

atoms.name: register_course_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students must be able to register for their own current-semester offering while registration is open.

atoms.name: add_course_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students must be able to add their own current selections during add/drop.

atoms.name: report_card_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: Students must be able to view their own previous-semester report cards.

atoms.name: select_teaching_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: Eligible professors must be able to select conflict-free upcoming offerings before registration closes.

atoms.name: enter_grade_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: Professors must be able to enter grades for their completed classes.

atoms.name: registrar_close_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: Registrar must be able to close current registration.

atoms.name: liveness_register
atoms.plain_english_summary: At least one student registration request should be possible.

atoms.name: liveness_enter_grade
atoms.plain_english_summary: At least one professor grade-entry request should be possible.

atoms.name: liveness_close_registration
atoms.plain_english_summary: At least one registrar close-registration request should be possible.
